subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should visible reasoning formatting be a shared agent-level presentation policy with channel capability fallbacks, a Telegram/plugin-owned setting, or remain fixed while reasoning visibility alone stays configurable?
rationale: The answer establishes a new durable config/API boundary, precedence rules, and the expected behavior for channels that cannot faithfully render every proposed format.

options.title: Adopt a portable policy
options.body: Add a small shared format vocabulary with italic as the default and channel adapters using documented fallbacks for unsupported styles.

options.title: Keep it channel-owned
options.body: Allow the Telegram plugin to define its own supported presentation setting without adding a cross-channel runtime contract.

options.title: Defer the setting
options.body: Keep the fixed presentation and rely on the existing reasoning visibility controls until broader channel presentation policy is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Adopt a portable policy
recommendation.body: Add a small shared format vocabulary with italic as the default and channel adapters using documented fallbacks for unsupported styles.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reasoning formatter and its runtime delivery paths are the central decision surface in the available feature history.
